mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 700000 over the past 2 months indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue growth expectations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 700000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 320), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS has increased over the past 6 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100) in a 3-month window, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 and a rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 325 over the past 3 months indicates weakening consumer demand and inflationary pressures, signaling a negative economic outlook and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400 and CPIAUCSL > 325, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% annually), a decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 signals a cooling housing market, a leading indicator of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400 and GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
